programme.title: SchleFaZ: Cleopatra Wong – Die Unüberwindliche
programme.desc: In der satirischen Reihe werden jede Woche handverlesene Trashfilm-Perlen von Oliver Kalkofe und Peter Rütten präsentiert. Die Filme zeichnen sich durch eine unfreiwillig schlechte Machart oder besonders skurrile Ideen aus und werden von den Kult-Comedians gnadenlos kommentiert, persifliert und mit scharfer Klinge seziert. Die Show wird zu einer grandiosen Watch-Party mit eigenen Cocktails, Trinkspiel und jeder Menge Spaß. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great White – Hol tief Luft
programme.desc:
Charterpilot Charlie (Aaron Jakubenko) und seine schwangere Verlobte Kaz (Katrina Bowden) bieten Charterflüge an. Als sie mit ihrem Bordkoch Benny und ihren Kunden Michelle und Joe unterwegs zu einem Riff sind, entdecken sie plötzlich die Leiche von einem Segler an einem abgelegenen Strand. Kurze Zeit später finden sie auch das Wrack seines Schiffes sowie die Leiche seiner Freundin, zerfetzt.

Charlie landet mit seinem Wasserflugzeug auf dem Ozean, doch da demoliert ein weißer Hai den Flieger! Die Gruppe rettet sich in ein Notfall-Floß, aber der Hai erweist sich als anhänglich und ist nicht allein...

B-Film in Hochglanzbildern.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Eine abwechslungsreiche Verkaufssendung präsentiert eine breite Auswahl an Artikeln für Alltag und Freizeit. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern über eleganten Schmuck bis zu modernen Elektrogeräten ist alles dabei. Zudem werden aktuelle Modelle aus der Welt der Mobiltelefone sowie hochwertige Foto- und Filmkameras vorgestellt. Ergänzt wird das Angebot durch zahlreiche Produkte aus dem medizinischen Bereich, die das Wohlbefinden fördern, die Gesundheit unterstützen und den Alltag spürbar bereichern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Die lustigsten Schlamassel der Welt
programme.desc: Die lustigsten Schlamassel der Welt – das sind herrliche Missgeschicke am laufenden Band! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Beim Verhör eines Schmalspur-Kriminellen kommen Tubbs und Crockett auf eine heiße Spur. Izzy Moreno gesteht, er habe für einen Drogenhändler Kurierdienste geleistet. Die beiden Fahnder vom Drogendezernat sind sich sicher, dass das ein Hinweis auf den seit langer Zeit gesuchten Drogenkönig Louis McCarthy ist. Tubbs lernt McCarthy kennen und gibt sich ihm gegenüber als begeisterter Fan von Offshore-Booten aus. Der Mafiosi schluckt den Köder. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Crockett und Tubbs wollen Joey Bramlett dazu bringen, gegen einen Schmugglerring auszusagen. Trotz aller Sicherheitsmaßnahmen gelingt ihm die Flucht. Die Ermittler nehmen die Verfolgung auf. Die Spur führt in die Sümpfe der Everglades. Die beiden Fahnder tarnen sich als Fischer; doch anstatt wertvolle Hinweise über den Verbleib von Bramlett zu erhalten, beziehen sie Prügel von abweisenden Dorfbewohnern. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Alvarado, eine dubiose Figur aus Miamis Unterwelt, wird auf Kaution entlassen. Sein rechtlicher Vertreter ist der Anwalt Cain, der unbedingt von Sonny den Namen eines Informanten erfahren will, um seinen Mandanten zu entlasten. Als Sonny sich weigert, den Namen zu nennen, wird er wegen Missachtung des Gerichts verhaftet. In der Zwischenzeit versucht Gina, als Prostituierte getarnt, Informationen über den Zuhälterkönig Lupo Ramirez zu bekommen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miami Vice
programme.desc: Crockett und Tubbs kommen gerade rechtzeitig, um ihre Kolleginnen Gina und Trudy aus einer gefährlichen Situation zu retten. Die beiden waren undercover als Junkies im Einsatz. In einem alten Hotel in Miami schnappte die Falle zu. Ihr einziger Hinweis ist der junge Mark Jorgenson, Sohn eines reichen Geschäftsmannes, den sie mitnehmen. Der Junior hat ein Drogenproblem, das er nicht in den Griff bekommt. Bald will er eine Therapie machen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Um Lisa und Kosoff freizubekommen, hat MacGyver zusammen mit seinem Freund Jack Dalton einen kostbaren Ming-Drachen gestohlen. Nachts auf einem Werksgelände soll der Austausch stattfinden. General Racoubian hat MacGyver zwar erzählt, dass Kosoff bei einem Fluchtversuch ums Leben gekommen sei, aber Lisa ist sich sicher, dass ihr Mann noch am Leben ist. Bei dem Versuch, auch ihn zu befreien, geraten MacGyver und Dalton in eine tödliche Falle. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Die neue Identität des Ex-Mafiakillers Jimmy Kendall fliegt auf, als dessen Bild in einer Zeitung erscheint. MacGyver und Pete Thornton sehen sich gezwungen, ihn im Rahmen des Zeugenschutzprogrammes mit einer neuen Identität zu versehen. Ihre Pläne werden jedoch durchkreuzt, als die Mafialeute, für die Jimmy einst arbeitete, entdecken, dass er noch lebt, und seine Tochter und seinen Enkelsohn kidnappen, um ihn aus dem Versteck zu locken. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: In einer Bucht in der Wildnis Alaskas entdeckt MacGyver ein scheinbar verlassenes Schiff. Als er an Bord geht, wird er von einem Ungeheuer angegriffen. Auf der Flucht trifft er Karin, die sich als blinder Passagier auf dem Schiff versteckt hat, um ihren Vater in Alaska zu treffen. Sie berichtet, dass das Monster die ganze Besatzung getötet habe. Bevor MacGyver Karin in Sicherheit bringen kann, entdecken sie einen Öldiebstahl aus einer Piperline. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.sub-title: Wer zuletzt lacht, lacht am besten
programme.desc: Danny Barrett, ein Freund MacGyvers, wird getötet, kurz bevor er einen Juwelenraub aufklären konnte. MacGyver schwört, den Fall zu lösen und seinen Freund zu rächen. Gemeinsam mit Dannys Schwester Nikki Carpenter tüftelt er einen Plan aus, um Amir Sumal, den Kulturattaché einer ausländischen Botschaft, zu überführen. Sie vermuten, dass sich Sumal hinter seiner diplomatischen Immunität versteckt, um nicht angeklagt werden zu können. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: Vandaag doet de Winterse Kost van Bart het werk voor hem. Hij maakt een hot pot klaar van rijst, zeeduivel en winterse groentjes. Alles in één grote pot en lekker laten pruttelen in de oven!

programme.title: The Expendables 2

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Een Amerikaanse overheidsagent (Milla Jovovich) overleeft ternauwernood een bomaanslag in het centrum van Londen. programme.title: Hellboy Animated: Sword of Storms
programme.desc: Wanneer een universiteitsprofessor een verboden boekrol opent, raakt hij bezeten door de tweelingdemonen van donder en bliksem die naar onze wereld proberen terug te keren om hun broers, de draken, wakker te maken.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Jane Hammond is een voorbeeldige vrouw die getrouwd is met Bill, een van de slechtste mannen die er in de stad rondloopt. Als Bill zich tegen zijn eigen bende keert en op een dag halfdood thuis komt met acht kogels in zijn rug, neemt Jane zelf een wapen ter handen om orde op zaken te stellen.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: De nieuwste film van Steven Soderbergh (Magic Mike, Ocean's Eleven/Twelve/Thirteen) gaat over twee broers die het lumineuze idee krijgen om een onmogelijke roofoverval te plegen tijdens een bloedstollend Nascar race evenement op de Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina.

programme.title: The Wolf's Call
programme.desc: Aan boord van een Franse nucleaire onderzeeër heeft een jonge officier het uitzonderlijke talent om de geluiden van vijandige onderzeeërs te identificeren. Als hij een foute inschatting maakt zet hij niet alleen zijn reputatie op het spel, maar ook de levens van de hele bemanning.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Southern States
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.desc: How can port cities stay resilient amid global trade uncertainty? A sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo was held at the Ningbo Zhoushan Port — the world's No.1 port in cargo throughput for 17 straight years. CGTN's Michael Wang spoke with Ningbo's Vice Mayor and guests from Cotonou (Benin), Klang Royal City (Malaysia) and Toamasina (Madagascar). Arctic shipping routes, green corridors, sister-port cooperation — the insights keep coming.

Learn more at this sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in #Ningbo. #Zhejiang.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China's rare wildlife and their habitats. programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen.

programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions.

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Spencer's Big Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine EP 4
programme.desc: Chryso Lefou makes a light and tasty Mediterranean dish with fresh pasta, colourful mint pesto, and juicy cherry tomatoes. She makes crispy fried almond fingers (Dactyla) for dessert, which adds a nutty, sweet finish. A delectable blend of decadent treats and savoury, fresh flavours.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Barcelona
programme.desc: Barcelona, Spain, is a city close to Malini's heart. Returning after her student years, she retraces old steps to see how the city has changed. Barcelona, one of Europe’s most visited cities, still holds centuries-old charm. Malina's old haunts include El Gòtic, Sant Antoni, Passeig de Gràcia, and Barceloneta. visits Gaudí’s iconic Casa La Pedrera, and discovers the new wave of creative tapas restaurants in El Raval, a once run-down quarter now bursting with energy.

programme.title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.desc: From rough blocks of stone to expressive works of art, Reuben Mallia reveals the patience and skill behind traditional Mediterranean stone carving. Fadi steps into his world to discover how simple tools, careful craftsmanship, and countless hours of work can bring solid rock to life.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

Daar ontmoet ze Gijsbert, een dakloze die onder bruggen slaapt en zijn weinige spullen in een boodschappenkar meeneemt. Een auto komt hard langsrijden: splash! Een grote golf plenst over hen heen en maakt hen zeiknat. Uit de auto stapt Katharina, die hen een meewarige blik toewerpt: zo, jullie zijn ook weer schoon.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers

Ze weet zich nergens anders te verstoppen dan onder tafel. Maar hoe komt ze hier weg? Ze bindt Jans’ veters aan elkaar en sprint ervandoor. Jan springt op, struikelt en belandt met zijn hoofd tegen de borsten van Lilka die net aan komt lopen. De verlekkerde grijns op zijn gezicht veegt Katharina er met een vakkundige tik vanaf.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers

En het water in de regenton is bijna verdampt. Hitte in de stad.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Ultieme verdediging: Nul blinde vlek
programme.desc: Naruto begint zijn aanval met zijn Schaduwklonen, maar Neji analyseert Naruto's acties en bepaalt wie de echte is. Omdat hij niet kan begrijpen waarom Naruto zijn nederlaag niet toegeeft, doet hij zijn hoofdband af en onthult een mysterieus teken op zijn voorhoofd. Neji onthult de waarheid over zijn haat tegen de belangrijkste familie van de Hyuga Clan.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Nu het nieuws van Sasuke's vertrek is doorgedrongen tot de Vijfde Hokage, roept ze de nieuwste Chunin, Shikamaru, op een team samen te stellen om Sasuke terug te brengen naar het dorp.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De ware kracht van een mislukking
programme.desc: Het gevecht tussen Naruto en Neji gaat verder en Neji toont enorme kracht.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Hit it or Quit it: De laatste rondes worden ingewikkeld!
programme.desc: Neiji wordt in het ziekenhuis bezocht door zijn oom Hiashi om de waarheid over de dood van zijn vader te vertellen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Als hun rivaliteit een hoogtepunt bereikt, verbreekt Kakashi-sensei het gevecht en stuurt Naruto en Sasuke naar hun hoeken. Ondertussen komen de vier Sound ninja's het Hidden Leaf Village binnen met maar één ding in hun gedachten - Sasuke.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Sasuke gaat het gevecht aan met alle vier de Sound Ninja tegelijk, vastbesloten zijn kracht te bewijzen. Maar al snel ontdekt hij dat zelfs zijn krachtige Chidori niet genoeg is om deze vijanden te verslaan — en dat hij misschien niet zo ver is als hij dacht.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: De vier Sound Ninja hebben Sasuke stevig in hun greep en zijn vastbesloten hem naar Orochimaru te brengen. Nu rust de taak op de schouders van enkele van de sterkste jonge Shinobi van het Hidden Leaf Village om hen tegen te houden — en Sasuke terug te brengen voor het te laat is.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Een plek om naar terug te keren
programme.desc: Shikamaru en zijn team lanceren een verrassingsaanval om Sasuke terug te halen, maar hun missie krijgt meteen een flinke klap wanneer Jirobo — een van de vier Sound Ninja — hen allemaal weet op te sluiten in een zware Earth Dome-gevangenis. Terwijl hij hun chakra langzaam wegzuigt, beseffen ze dat ontsnappen onmogelijk lijkt... tenzij ze slim samenwerken.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Bij hun ontsnapping uit de Earth Dome-gevangenis realiseert de Sasuke Retrieval Squad zich dat ze niet genoeg chakra hebben om het tegen Jirobo op te nemen, maar Choji heeft een ander idee.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Met zijn leven op het spel tegen de Sound Ninja Jirobo, kijkt Choji terug op de kiem van zijn vriendschap met Shikamaru. Kan hij zijn geduchte tegenstander verslaan zonder enige Chakra.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Op het spoor van Sasuke raken Shikamaru en zijn team verstrikt in een web van ongeëvenaarde chakra als ze in de clinch raken met de zesarmige Kidomaru.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Terwijl de rest van het team de achtervolging inzet op Sasuke en de overige Sound Ninja, blijft Neji achter om het alleen op te nemen tegen de zesarmige Kidômaru. In een strategisch en intens gevecht moet hij al zijn Byakugan-vaardigheden inzetten om te overleven — en zijn kameraden de tijd te geven om door te gaan.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Neji wordt onder vuur genomen door Kidomaru’s meedogenloze aanvallen met pijl en boog, die nauwkeurig zijn blinde vlek proberen te raken — het enige zwakke punt in zijn bijna perfecte verdediging. Terwijl de pijlen hem steeds dichter naderen, staat Neji voor de ultieme test: kan hij zijn zwakte overwinnen en levend uit dit dodelijke duel komen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: In achtervolging van de Sound Ninja slaan Naruto, Kiba en Shikamaru bij zonsopgang toe om Sasuke terug te halen en naar het Hidden Leaf Village te brengen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Kakashi Kronieken ~ Leven van jongens op het slagveld ~ Deel 1
programme.desc: Aruto, Kiba en Shikamaru onderscheppen Sasuke van de Sound Ninja Four, maar ze weten niet dat een andere ninja uit het Sound Village is gestuurd om Sasuke ook te grijpen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Kakashi Kronieken ~ Leven van jongens op het slagveld ~ Deel 2
programme.desc: Kiba en zijn trouwe partner Akamaru nemen het op tegen het meedogenloze tweelingduo Sakon en Ukon, die bekendstaan om hun gruwelijke synchronisatie en dodelijke technieken. Vastbesloten om hun missie te volbrengen en Sasuke terug te brengen, zetten Kiba en Akamaru alles op alles — en schakelen hun tegenstanders uit met hun krachtigste, perfect gecoördineerde jutsu.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Nu het team om Sasuke terug te halen is opgesplitst in individuele gevechten, is het aan Naruto, Kiba en Shikamaru om de geluidsninja te stoppen. Maar ze realiseren zich niet dat hun tegenstanders meer zijn dan hun basistechnieken.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Shikamaru staat tegenover Tayuya, een sluwe en gevaarlijke tegenstander die met haar vervloekte fluit dodelijke genjutsu en demonische wezens oproept. Terwijl haar melodieuze aanvallen steeds intenser worden, moet Shikamaru zijn strategisch inzicht tot het uiterste drijven om haar te slim af te zijn en een einde te maken aan haar duistere muziek — voordat het te laat is.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto's Schaduwklonen zijn geen partij voor Kimimaro's aanvallen. Maar als er een oud maatje met een borstelige wenkbrauw uit het Leaf Village opduikt, zijn alle kansen verkeken.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Rock Lee keert onverwachts terug en zit vol nieuwe energie dankzij een speciaal medicijn dat hij van Tsunade heeft gekregen. Met hernieuwde kracht en onvoorspelbare dronken vechtstijl weet hij Kimimaro flink in de problemen te brengen. Maar de vraag blijft: is het genoeg om de vijfde en gevaarlijkste Sound Ninja definitief uit te schakelen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Kiba, Shikamaru en Rock Lee zijn ten dode opgeschreven en overgeleverd aan de genade van de Sound Ninja. Ze krijgen hulp van een onwaarschijnlijke groep nieuwe bondgenoten.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Met zin om te vechten en een schuldgevoel uit het verleden zegt Gaara tegen Rock Lee dat hij moet stoppen en het tegen Kimimaro op mag nemen. Ondertussen gaat Naruto door met zijn zoektocht om de weggelopen Sasuke te vangen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Verhalen van een dappere ninja - Jiraiya Ninja Scroll (Deel 1)
programme.desc: Terwijl Gaara laat zien dat hij meer dan genoeg ruggengraat heeft om het tegen Kimimaro op te nemen, denkt Orochimaru terug aan hoe hij hem als jongeman het Sound Village binnenbracht.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Verhalen van een dappere ninja - Jiraiya Ninja Scroll (Deel 2)
programme.desc: Eindelijk heeft hij Sasuke ingehaald en Naruto doet er alles aan om te voorkomen dat hij naar Orochimaru gaat. Heeft hij genoeg kracht om hem te stoppen of is Sasuke voorgoed verdwenen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Infiltreren! Het dorp verborgen in de regen
programme.desc: Naruto en Sasuke gaan de strijd met elkaar aan terwijl we een kijkje krijgen in Sasuke's verleden, waar zijn prestaties werden genegeerd door zijn vader en het gedrag van zijn broer Itachi een wending naar het slechtste begon te nemen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Terwijl Sasuke het opneemt tegen Naruto, denkt hij na over zijn verleden, toen hij werd verwaarloosd door zowel zijn strenge vader als Itachi, zijn piekerende oudere broer.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Terwijl Naruto onder water bezig is, denkt Sasuke terug aan de noodlottige dag waarop zijn clan werd gedood. Hij herinnert zich waarom Itachi zijn leven spaarde en waarom Itachi deed wat hij deed. Om nu dezelfde kracht te krijgen als zijn broer, moet hij zijn beste vriend doden...Naruto.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden The Movie: The Will of Fire
programme.desc: In alle grote shinobi-naties zijn ninja's met speciale bloedlijnen spoorloos verdwenen. Naruto en de rest van Team Kakashi hebben verwondingen opgelopen tijdens hun onderzoek en gaan terug naar Konoha om te genezen, maar niet lang na hun terugkeer verschijnt er een verschijning van een jongen in de lucht.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden The Movie: The Lost Tower
programme.desc: Tijdens een routinemissie om een schurk genaamd Mukade te vangen in de verwoeste stad Rouran, raakt Naruto verstrikt in een enorme explosie van chakra die hem naar het verleden transporteert. Als hij wakker wordt, bevindt de jonge ninja zich in een onbekende metropool en begint hij te verkennen.

Samen met wildexpert Gert Michiels maakt Jan een tocht doorheen het Vlaamse landschap, om telkens één specifiek dier en zijn habitat te ontdekken en er meer over te weten te komen. Zeker om 8u30. Ook deze ochtend zit hun hippe ontbijtbar goed vol. Will Yugi attack and advance in the finals, or will he surrender to save Bakura’s life but lose the only chance to protect the world from Marik’s evil.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: The origin of the Egyptian God Cards is finally revealed! The mysterious Shadi takes Yugi on a journey back in time to the creation of Duel Monsters… and the dangerous powers it released.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: In the second duel of the Battle City Finals, Odion, disguised as Marik, befuddles Joey with numerous traps to bring the duel to a stalemate. However, Joey has Giant Trunade, the perfect counter to Odion’s strategy that guarantees Joey victory… or is Joey falling into another trap.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Odion’s Embodiments of Apophis run roughshod over Joey’s monsters… and his life points! Can Joey effectively utilize the monsters he won earlier in the tournament, or is he already too flustered to mount a successful counterattack.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: It’s a feeding frenzy as Odion’s Serket devours Joey’s monsters to morph into greater and powerful stages of evolution! How can Joey defeat Serket when it ingests Joey’s monsters whenever they’re summoned on to the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Odion uses a phony Egyptian God Card to summon the third Egyptian God Monster The Winged Dragon of Ra and targets it to annihilate the rest of Joey’s life points! However, is Odion able to control the ultimate power of an Egyptian God, or will The Winged Dragon of Ra punish all those unworthy of summoning it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 1
programme.desc: The third duel of the Battle City Finals between Mai and Marik is no ordinary duel; it’s a battle in the dreaded Shadow Realm where losing life points equals losing your memories! As Marik’s true sinister self comes to the surface, does Mai stand a chance against this malevolent evil.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 2
programme.desc: As Mai loses more and more of her memories under Marik’s relentless assault, she loses confidence in her dueling abilities. Will Yugi and friends’ neverending support bring her back to victory, or will her shattered mind be trapped in the Shadow Realm for eternity.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 3
programme.desc: Mai gains control of Marik’s The Winged Dragon of Ra, but she’s unable to decipher how to unleash its massively powerful abilities! Can Mai solve the mystery of the Egyptian God Card before Marik solves it himself and incinerates Mai with the full fury of The Winged Dragon of Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 1
programme.desc: In the fourth duel of the Battle City Finals, Kaiba’s mystery opponent is… Ishizu! With the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play! Does Kaiba stand a chance against an opponent who knows his moves even before he does.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 2
programme.desc: Ishizu, using the magic of her Millennium Necklace, has already seen the outcome of the duel – she will defeat Kaiba with her trap! How can Kaiba win when it’s already destined that he will lose? It’s time for Kaiba to change the future.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Marik’s evil grows, Ishizu reveals the secrets of her bloodline: How did Marik transform from a kind child into a power-hungry tyrant out for world domination? Can Yugi save Marik from the edge of darkness, or is he already beyond salvation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 1
programme.desc: With their previous pact broken, Bakura duels Marik for the right to control the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring, and the loser will be trapped inside the Shadow Realm forever! To tip the odds, Bakura gains an unexpected ally in the form of… another Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura and good Marik summon The Winged Dragon of Ra, ready to blast and banish evil Marik into the Shadow Realm! But The Winged Dragon of Ra has more than one special ability, and evil Marik knows how to use them all.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Kaiba’s blimp speeds towards KaibaCorp Island for the final rounds of the Battle City Tournament, the ship is hijacked by a mysterious boy named Noah and his henchmen – five familiar foes from Yugi and Kaiba’s past who are out for revenge! With the power of cyberspace on Noah’s side, Yugi and friends are trapped inside a new and dangerous Duel Monsters game.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Noah displays the power of his virtual world by splitting up Yugi’s gang and flinging them into the far reaches of his self-created universe! The first to duel under the all-new Deck Master System is Yugi against Big 1 Gansley’s Deepsea Warrior! Can Yugi master the complex new rules, or will the rules master him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against Gansley, in the form of "Deepsea Warrior.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi's strategy is hindered by Gansley's Deck Master ability. Tristan and Duke face a mean dinosaur to save Serenity. Meanwhile, Kaiba and Mokuba confront painful visions of their miserable childhood, but within the heartache may lurk the key to Noah's true intentions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Téa is led by a penguin to Crump, in the form of Nightmare Penguin, who challenges her to a duel. She learns immediately that dueling in the virtual realm differs starkly from her previous duels, and starts to succumb to the virtual playing field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Despite gaining a lead with Maha Vailo, Téa falls behind as Crump begins an assault on her life points, causing the ice around her to grow. With the help of her Deck Master, Dark Magician Girl, and Yugi's Dark Magician, Téa gains enough confidence to win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey faces the Big 5's lawyer, Johnson, in a courtroom duel. Joey pulls an early lead with his Deck Master, Flame Swordsman, but Johnson's Deck Master, Judge Man, has abilities of his own.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Joey attempts to pull through with several luck-based cards, but Johnson's cheating tactics ruin all his chances, until an angry Noah puts a stop to him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: With Lector's Jinzo Deck Master destroying all of Kaiba's traps, Imperial Order destroying all his spell cards, and Lector's unreachable Satellite Cannon striking from space, Kaiba doesn't seem to stand a chance. Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba keeps him believing that his brother will pull out with a victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.desc: Yugi, Kaiba, and Tea are separated from the others as the Big 5 (minus Nesbitt) plan to take their bodies anyway. As Noah tortures Kaiba by brainwashing Mokuba, he reveals his true identity as Gozaboro Kaiba's biological son.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 1
programme.desc: Noah gives the Big Five one last chance to redeem themselves in a five-on-two tag team duel where Yugi and Joey take on the entire Big Five, who are using Tristan's body.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh
programme.sub-title: Merger of the Big Five — Part 2
programme.desc: The Big 5 attempt various strategies of victory, with the aim of eliminating Joey first. However, their poor teamwork soon puts Yugi and Joey ahead. Lector then calls their most powerful monster to the field, the Five Head Dragon.

programme.title: Z Nation

programme.title: Z Nation

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: The group discovers Altura militia forces have enslaved talkers to mine hazardous waste for Z-bizkuits.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: With help from renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Estes imprisons the captive talkers and blends, while Warren and George plan their attack on Altura.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren works with humans, talkers and blends to help George defeat Estes and Pandora. Newmericans can finally vote, but before Warren can relax, Cooper reappears with a shocking revelation.

This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Southern States
programme.desc: We travel from Georgia through the Carolinas to Virginia, ending near Washington, DC. Along the way we meet a Georgia farmer; talk to painter J. Chris Wilson in Charleston; sail along the Outer Banks of Carolina, and visit rural Virginia, experiencing life in the beautiful southern states.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay - Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The Parque Nacional Peneda-Gerês is the only national park in Portugal. An area of almost 700 square kilometers, located in the extreme north of Portugal. Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The highest mountain range in Portugal is the Serra da Estrela. The episode embarks on a voyage of discovery to adventurous rock formations and villages steeped in tradition. The nature park is the largest protected area on the Iberian peninsula. In the mountain range we accompany the young scientist Ana Matos, who wants to breathe new life into old traditions, and cheese maker Maria Natália Lopes. She watches over more than 350 sheeps.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.sub-title: South West Portugal: Alentejano and Costa Vicentina
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: mareTV: In Alaska's Fjord World
programme.desc: Gigantic fjords and over 5,000 small islands: In Alaska's south there's a lot of wilderness and little civilization. The region between the capital Juneau and the Canadian border is also known by locals as the "Last Frontier.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland - Winter in the Swiss Alps
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It’s a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It’s a country that’s astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Dialogue at the world's largest port: Building resilient port cities together
programme.desc: How can port cities stay resilient amid global trade uncertainty? A sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo was held at the Ningbo Zhoushan Port — the world's No.1 port in cargo throughput for 17 straight years. CGTN's Michael Wang spoke with Ningbo's Vice Mayor and guests from Cotonou (Benin), Klang Royal City (Malaysia) and Toamasina (Madagascar). Arctic shipping routes, green corridors, sister-port cooperation — the insights keep coming.

programme.title: Smart governance, shared future: How innovation is changing our cities
programme.desc: Robots that write, grasp objects and work on real production lines are becoming an everyday reality in Ningbo. How is innovation transforming our cities? Learn more at this sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in #Ningbo. #Zhejiang.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China's rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Lobster Curry and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion

programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and more! programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen.

programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions.

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Spencer's Big Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.desc: Gnistene flyr når en kjekk fremmed melder seg frivillig til å hjelpe en vellykket kvinne med å organisere familiens årlige julefestival. Men han er egentlig en prins i forkledning, og det vil kreve et mirakel av kongelige proporsjoner for at hjertene deres skal møtes som ett.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming To Christmas Dinner
programme.desc: Den aktivistiske, liberale og progressive jusstudenten Maya tar med seg sin nye kjæreste hjem til jul uten å fortelle familien at han er hvit. Gjett hvem som kommer til julemiddag.

programme.title: Mitt Julemotell
programme.desc: Når foretningskvinne Jennifer blir informert om at foreledrene hennes er bortreist i juleferien uten henne, bestemmer hun seg for å reise vekk fra det travsomme bylivet i San Francisco for å besøke hennes bestemors motel i Alaska som ble etterlatt til henne for renovasjon og salg.

programme.title: Christmas Wonderland
programme.desc: Juletid i NYC er alt annet enn fantastisk for den strevende artisten Heidi Neill.

programme.title: Nøkkelen til Jul
programme.desc: Når en misfornøyd alv tar over Nordpolen, snur hun tiden bakover og julenissen blir yngre… fort! Det er opp til en lojal alv, en liten jente med en magisk nøkkel og den nå tenåringsnissen å redde fremtiden til julen.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: Basert på boken fra den bestselgende krimforfatteren Mary Higgins Clark kommer denne julens krimgåte. En kvinnelig detektiv slår seg sammen med en amatøretterforsker for å finne sin savnede far.

programme.title: Anna and the Apocalypse
programme.desc: Julepynt og bjelleklang, musikalsang og zombieapokalypse. Midt i julestrien trues småbyen Little Haven av en nær forestående undergang. Anna og vennene hennes bestemmer seg for å bekjempe zombiehordene – men hvem kan man stole på i en verden som faller sammen.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: Betty går aldri glipp av en episode av hennes favoritt såpeopera «A Reason to Love». Etter en kursendrende krasj med to hit-menn mens hun ser en episode, forvandler Betty seg til «Nurse Betty» og legger ut på et oppdrag for å finne hennes eneste sanne kjærlighet, Dr. David Ravell.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Fire krigsveteraner som har overlevd Vietnam-krigens fangeleirer, bestemmer seg for å gjennomføre en siste flukt – fra gamlehjemmet. Men det byr på utfordringer å planlegge en flukt med en gruppe senile.

programme.title: How To Be A Latin Lover
programme.desc: Møt Maximo, en ung mann som drømmer om å bli rik uten å ha måttet jobbe en dag i livet. Etter å ha gjort karriere med å forføre rike eldre kvinner, gifter han seg med en velstående kvinne som er mer enn dobbelt så gammel som seg selv.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: ”Peace, Love & Misunderstanding” er et hjertevarmt portrett av en fargerik familie. Filmen forteller historien om Diane, en småsær New York City advokat som har et desperat behov for å flykte etter ektemannen ber om skilsmisse.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: I jakten på en rømt fange går agent Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) undercover som en overdimensjonert, anmassende sørstatsbestemor med en holdning som er like tøff som svinekotelettene hennes.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Man kan komme langt med et glass champagne og et klask på rompa! En frustrert forretningskvinne på salgsturné? Og en sleip motellsjef med smak for billig champagne og runde bakdeler? Ingen vinnerformel, men mye kan skje på et avsidesliggende motell..

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael.
